description: This file defines a report parser class for account balance reports in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including methods for generating and formatting account and fiscal year data.

classes.name: account_balance
classes.description: Parser class for account balance report, handling data processing and formatting for report generation.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing report parser with context and setting up local variables.

methods.name: linesForYear
methods.description: Generates a list of fiscal years for report display, setting global formatting options.

methods.name: linesForTotal
methods.description: Calculates total debit and credit for accounts over fiscal years.

methods.name: lines
methods.description: Recursively retrieves account lines with balances, formatting, and hierarchical structure.

methods.name: get_years
methods.description: Returns list of fiscal years with labels for report headers.

methods.name: get_lines
methods.description: Retrieves account lines for a specific year, including balances and patterns.

methods.name: cal_total
methods.description: Calculates total debit and credit for a given year.
